mapper.select: SELECT M.*, MG.*, COALESCE(O.total_payment, 0) AS total_payment, count(*) AS member_cnt FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN MEMBERSHIP_GRADE MG ON M.member_id = MG.member_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT member_id, SUM(final_amount) AS total_payment FROM ORDERS GROUP BY member_id ) O ON M.member_id = O.member_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount,
SUM( CASE WHEN CREATED_AT >= CURDATE() AND CREATED_AT < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS todayCount,
SUM( CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS activeCount,
SUM( CASE WHEN status = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS dormantCount
FROM MEMBER;
